overviewFields.title: Limitless. Lossless.
overviewFields.value: The wired world is changing. Where once cables were king, Bluetooth audio is now carving out a place for itself, and with the advent of Lossless Bluetooth audio, the gap between wired and wireless audiophile options is narrower than ever. The ZEN Blue 3 brings these two worlds together in spectacular fashion. Building on the resounding success of the ZEN Blue range, iFi took everything that made them great and dared themselves to do more. Adding aptX Lossless was iFi’s ‘small step’. Their ‘giant leap’ came when they added USB DAC capability, and Bluetooth transmission. With USB, optical and even analogue inputs available, there have never been more ways to connect to the music you love, while enjoying the freedom of wireless Hi-Res audio.

overviewFields.title: Cut the Cord. Keep the Quality.
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Blue 3 offers wireless audio that is free of compromise by incorporating Lossless Bluetooth audio, courtesy of Qualcomm’s Flagship QCC518x Bluetooth audio chip and the aptX Lossless codec. Offering a maximum bitrate of 1,200kbps aptX Lossless is the first and only Bluetooth codec currently capable of wirelessly sending and receiving CD-quality audio without losing data during compression. For instance, if your phone supports aptX Lossless, you can stream high-quality lossless music from your phone to your hi-fi system. Not ready to join the Lossless party just yet? Not to worry, they’ve got you covered. The ZEN Blue 3’s extensive backwards compatibility ensures that all current major Bluetooth codecs are supported: aptX Lossless, LDAC™, LHDC/HWA, aptX Adaptive, aptX, AAC and SBC.

overviewFields.title: Forging New Connections
overviewFields.value: In this increasingly wireless world, high resolution Bluetooth headphones and TWS (True Wireless Stereo) earbuds are an essential for audio enthusiasts. However, the need for a Bluetooth connection can often make them incompatible with your home audio setup. The ZEN Blue 3 tears down this wall with Bluetooth transmission in all supported codecs, including CD-quality aptX Lossless. Connect your ZEN Blue 3 to audio sources such as laptops, mobile phones or TVs, via USB-C, SPDIF or even analogue RCA, and introduce your favorite Bluetooth headphones or earbuds to the rest of your audio world. Whether it’s a late-night vinyl session without the speakers, enjoying your aptX Lossless earbuds while working on your laptop, or marathoning your favorite Netflix series on the TV via headphones, the ZEN Blue 3 offers new opportunities for listening enjoyment.

overviewFields.title: Versatility Breeds Possibility
overviewFields.value: Even with all this innovation on show, the ZEN Blue 3 has even more tricks up its sleeve. Leveraging the capabilities of the Qualcomm QCC518x chipset paired with a dedicated ESS Sabre DAC and Hi-Fi circuitry, it outperforms most Bluetooth transmitters and receivers. The ZEN Blue 3 is also able to function as a fully wired DAC, offering 96kHz/24Bit audio via USB-C, or 192kHz/24Bit audio via SPDIF, which can be output via 4.4 balanced or RCA analogue outputs.

overviewFields.title: Let That Sync In
overviewFields.value: Whether you’re getting lost in a great movie or immersing yourself in your favorite video game, few things take you out of the moment quite like a delay in the audio. This is a notorious issue with other Bluetooth products, but for the ZEN Blue 3 this is simply another place to excel. When using ZEN Blue 3’s Low Latency mode with a device receiver that supports aptX Low Latency, the time taken to send and receive audio is drastically reduced. When your eyes see it, your ears hear it – putting you right back in the moment, where you belong.

overviewFields.title: Balance in All Things
overviewFields.value: With so many Hi-Res audio options available to the ZEN Blue 3, making balanced circuitry available to users is more important than ever. By including a balanced line output, users with a balanced audio setup can look forward to significantly reduced signal noise and crosstalk between channels, bringing all the clarity with none of the audio clutter.

overviewFields.title: Amp it up
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN is an amplifier pure and simple. It simply takes an input signal from a source such as those mentioned above and creates a larger copy of the original signal before it’s sent to your headphones. Think about listening to sounds with your hands over your ears and then removing them! Adding the ZEN Air CAN into your system is a little like that – back comes clarity of sound as well as volume.

overviewFields.title: Lots to gain…
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN comes with three gain settings so that it works well with every pair of headphones or in-ear monitors (also known as IEMs). What is gain? Gain in audio terms refers to an amplifier’s ability to increase the amplitude (size) of the signal from the source (input) to the headphones or speakers (output).  More gain equals a stronger signal. You will need to adjust the gain depending on the sensitivity of the headphones or iEMs you are using. For example, highly sensitive headphones need lower gain. Play around with the settings. Trust your ears.

overviewFields.title: eSpecially for you
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN has two different headphone sockets – 6.3mm single-ended and 4.4mm S-Balanced. There are basically two types of headphones – single-ended and balanced. In a nutshell, single-ended is the most common but the balanced option is often considered the better as it offers more power and control of the headphones. At iFi, they know not everyone has balanced headphones, so they've created S-Balanced technology. This gives you all the benefits of a balanced connection – lower noise, less crosstalk – but without the need for balanced headphones.

overviewFields.title: Sonic tailoring
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN boasts a couple of sonic tweaks, unique to iFi. XBass is an analog bass boost. In other words, it extends the bass response to suit different headphones. XSpace is an analog headphone spatializer. This opens up your music to give you the spaciousness of a live-concert atmosphere.

overviewFields.title: Innovative TripleView™ Power Output Meter
overviewFields.value: The MC257 features the distinctive TripleView™ Power Output Meter, which simultaneously displays real-time power levels for the front left, center, and right channels. This 15-inch (38 cm) wide meter consolidates three indicators into a single, streamlined display, maintaining the classic McIntosh aesthetic while enhancing user convenience. For optimal viewing, the signature blue meter lighting can be deactivated to prevent distraction during movie sessions.

overviewFields.title: Enhanced Power Output for Superior Performance
overviewFields.value: Delivering 250 watts to each of the front three channels and 200 watts to all seven channels, the MC257 provides ample power to drive a comprehensive home theater setup. Thanks to McIntosh's Dynamic Power Manager® (DPM) technology, this robust output is consistently supplied to both 4 and 8 Ohm speakers, ensuring versatility and compatibility with a wide range of audio systems.

overviewFields.title: Significant Increase in Dynamic Headroom
overviewFields.value: With a 20% boost in filter capacity, the MC257 achieves a remarkable 94% increase in dynamic headroom, elevating it from 1.7dB to 3.3dB. This enhancement results in improved low-frequency performance, delivering deep, impactful bass that enriches the overall listening experience—particularly beneficial when enjoying dynamic movie soundtracks.

overviewFields.title: Advanced Cooling System for Silent Operation
overviewFields.value: Equipped with five McIntosh Monogrammed Heatsinks™ connected to advanced high-current output transistors, the MC257 efficiently dissipates heat without the need for noisy cooling fans. This design ensures silent operation, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in your entertainment without unwanted background noise. Additionally, a specially wound toroidal isolation power transformer minimizes electrical noise, preserving audio purity.

overviewFields.title: Versatile Integration Options
overviewFields.value: The MC257 offers both balanced and unbalanced inputs, facilitating seamless integration with various home theater processors and components. Its flexible design allows it to power a 7-channel home theater independently, complement digital amplifiers like the MI128 or MI254 in larger setups, or serve a 5-channel theater while allocating two channels to a secondary audio zone.

overviewFields.title: Protective Technologies for Reliable Performance
overviewFields.value: Incorporating McIntosh's proprietary Power Guard® technology, the MC257 prevents speaker damage caused by clipping or overdriving. The Sentry Monitor™ system safeguards against short circuits by disengaging the output stage if current exceeds safe levels, automatically resetting when normal conditions resume. These protective measures ensure the amplifier's longevity and dependable performance.

overviewFields.title: Elegant Design with User-Friendly Features
overviewFields.value: The MC257 boasts a polished stainless-steel chassis and the iconic McIntosh black glass front panel, complete with the TripleView™ meter, illuminated logo, and aluminum end caps. The front panel utilizes direct LED backlighting for enhanced color accuracy and durability. Updated gold-plated speaker binding posts prevent corrosion and ensure a high-quality signal transmission to your speakers.

overviewFields.title: Versatile Connectivity Options
overviewFields.value: Equipped with both Moving Coil (MC) and Moving Magnet (MM) inputs, the MP100 accommodates a wide range of phono cartridges. It provides adjustable loading settings—six for each input type—allowing precise matching to your cartridge specifications. The preamplifier includes balanced and unbalanced analog outputs, as well as optical, coaxial, and USB digital outputs, ensuring seamless integration into various audio setups. For pure analog listening, the digital outputs can be disabled to maintain signal integrity.

overviewFields.title: Mono Playback Enhancement
overviewFields.value: A dedicated Mono switch is included to optimize playback of mono records. This feature reduces noise and ensures accurate signal reproduction, delivering a cleaner and more authentic listening experience for mono recordings.

overviewFields.title: Seamless System Integration
overviewFields.value: The MP100's design allows for flexible incorporation into existing audio systems. Whether you're building a new setup, upgrading an older preamp, or adding vinyl capabilities to a home theater system, the MP100 offers the necessary connectivity and features without redundancy.

overviewFields.title: High-Quality Vinyl-to-Digital Conversion
overviewFields.value: For those interested in digitizing their vinyl collection, the MP100 facilitates high-quality recording. When connected to a computer via USB and used with appropriate software, it can convert records into digital files at 24-bit/96kHz resolution, capturing the full dynamic range of the vinyl. A clipping indicator alerts you to adjust levels, ensuring distortion-free recordings.

overviewFields.title: Compact and Elegant Design
overviewFields.value: True to McIntosh's renowned craftsmanship, the MP100 features a compact and aesthetically pleasing design. Its build quality and user-friendly interface make it a valuable addition to any audiophile's collection.
